firstPlayerRule: Players randomly decide who gets which group of Sun tiles; the player with the highest-numbered Sun begins. Play then continues clockwise.
clarifications: Sun groups are dealt out at random during setup, so the starting player is effectively chosen at random.
At the start of each later epoch, the player who now has the highest-numbered Sun begins.

internalEvidence: No rules download was found on the Rio Grande Games or 25th Century Games product pages. Downloaded the Rio Grande Games English rules as hosted by retailer World of Board Games Singapore (https://world-of-board-games.com.sg/docs/Ra.pdf), SHA-256 140b4147310254e1619231abebe8d5dd46e8561865f27a22127530091f97fd2b, and extracted the text of all 8 pages. The page slugs read SPR_RG_RA_ENG, and PDF page 8 lists Rio Grande Games, Rio Rancho NM, copyright 1998 Reiner Knizia and 2008 Rio Grande Games, Inc. PDF page 2: the players decide randomly which player receives which group of Suns. PDF page 3: the player with the highest numbered sun begins; play continues clockwise. PDF page 6: the player with the highest numbered sun begins the next epoch. Sun groups for 2 to 5 players and the tile-auction play match BGG 12. Page layout made printed folios unreliable in the text extract, so only PDF positions are cited. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The file is the Rio Grande Games rules hosted by a retailer, not on the publisher's own site.
The newer 25th Century Games edition rulebook was not available from the publisher and was not checked.

fairUse.rationale: Small clean box-front image identifies the Rio Grande Ra printing tied to the English rules in this starting-rule article. It is used for editorial reference with no more package artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Noble Knight lists the photographed Ra box as Rio Grande RGG119-09 at https://www.nobleknight.com/P/2147414146/Ra-2009-Edition, with the same 180 tiles, 16 suns, 48 VP tokens, Ra figure and cloth bag listed in the publisher-authored English rules at https://world-of-board-games.com.sg/docs/Ra.pdf. A parallel Rio Grande/Abacus publisher-authored German rules printing at https://www.ggnf.de/spielanleitungen/ra/ra.pdf carries ©2008 Rio Grande Games. The retailer calls this stocked printing 2009 while the rules copyright and catalog version date are 2008; the cover is identified as the late-2000s Rio Grande edition, not the separate 1999 box. The retailer image does not imply publisher permission. White margin trimmed and reduced to 360 pixels wide.
